scan.data_url_active: data: URL with HTML/JS: can run arbitrary code.
scan.document_cookie: document.cookie: reads or writes cookies (possible session exfiltration).
scan.document_write: document.write: injects content at runtime, an easy source of XSS.
scan.eval_call: eval() call: runs arbitrary code from a string.
scan.external_script_src_trusted: <script src> from an external host: {host} (trusted CDN).
scan.inline_event_handler: Inline event handler (onclick=, onerror=, ...). Consider addEventListener.
scan.javascript_protocol: href/src attribute with `javascript:`: runs code in the document's context.
scan.loopback_fetch: Private or loopback address: a sign of an SSRF attempt.
scan.meta_refresh: <meta http-equiv=refresh>: cross-origin redirect without user interaction.
scan.office_dde: The document contains a DDE field or link, which can run a command on the reader's computer.
scan.office_embedded_object: The document contains embedded objects (OLE, ActiveX), which a desktop editor can open or run.
scan.office_external_reference: The document refers to an external file (template or object) that a desktop editor may load.
scan.office_macros: The document contains macros, which can run code in a desktop editor.
scan.office_remote_template: The document loads a template from a remote address when opened, a known way to deliver malicious code.
scan.pdf_embedded_file: The PDF contains embedded files, which a reader can extract and open.
scan.pdf_javascript: The PDF contains JavaScript. The ICS viewer does not run it, but desktop readers may.
scan.pdf_launch_action: The PDF contains a launch action that can start a program on the reader's computer.
scan.pdf_xfa_form: The PDF contains an XFA form; the viewer shows the static pages only.
scan.prompt_injection_suspect: Text that reads like an instruction to an AI agent: "{phrase}". Check it before handing the document to an agent.
scan.svg_script: <script> inside <svg>: runs in the parent document's context and bypasses per-file heuristics.
scan.timer_string_arg: setTimeout/setInterval with a string: implicit eval.
